<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern—a dominant monoisotopic peak with a series of M+1, M+2, etc. decreasing roughly according to the natural 13C abundance—we can definitively identify carbon in the sample. No characteristic 2 Da spacing or ~1:1 intensity ratios indicative of chlorine or bromine are present, and other elements have isotopic contributions too small to be distinguished here.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
